name: io.github.0nork/crewai-mcp-local
title: CrewAI Local
description: Self-hosted, unlimited crewAI runs from any MCP client. Wraps the open-source crewAI Python library — no Enterprise quota. Counterpart to 0nmcp-crewai (Enterprise wrapper). Built by 0nORK.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Most crewAI agents need a model provider key. OpenAI is the default.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative provider — faster + cheaper for many crews.

environmentVariables.name: CREWAI_LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the LLM base URL — for self-hosted Ollama or custom endpoints.
